description: Pinocchio (non-Anchor) SOL escrow for agent payments, on Solana devnet. create_escrow and release were verified end-to-end: 1_000_000 lamports were locked in a program-owned PDA and paid to the seller; rent remains in the PDA. A zero-amount create is rejected. The official program id was not reused.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of ACRLABSDEV/pact. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/pact-escrow (Blockchains/pact already existed and is a different Tempo project). The lab changed crate::ID to a unique Sol.College devnet program and replaced pinocchio's nostd_panic_handler! with a plain #[panic_handler] so the crate builds on current platform-tools rustc. The hosted page is a custom wallet console (this is not an Anchor program). The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Program correctness on the Solana runtime (create_escrow, release)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/pact-escrow/
QA: devnet proof of create_escrow, release, and zero-amount rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Add a close instruction that returns remaining rent after release or refund
